picks.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
picks.why_it_matters: Signals extreme late-stage capital concentration in AI infrastructure plays, which could squeeze early-stage valuations or create acqui-hire pressure as smaller data/AI startups struggle to compete for talent and compute.

picks.title: Musk and Zuckerberg claw back into AI race with new model momentum
picks.why_it_matters: The AI foundation model race is consolidating around a handful of well-resourced players, reinforcing the thesis that early-stage opportunity lies in vertical applications and tooling rather than competing at the model layer.

picks.title: DeepSeek Harness developer preview
picks.why_it_matters: New developer tooling from a rising Chinese AI lab could lower barriers for startups building on open-weight models and signals continued fragmentation of the AI stack into investable infrastructure layers.
